def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    mid = w // 2
    left = [row[:mid] for row in grid]
    right = [row[mid+1:] for row in grid]
    shared = set(v for row in left for v in row) & set(v for row in right for v in row)
    other = next(iter(shared))
    return [[3 if a == b else other for a,b in zip(lrow,rrow)] for lrow,rrow in zip(left,right)]
print('demo1', transform(d1)==d1o, 'demo2', transform(d2)==d2o)
print('shareds', set(x for r in d1 for x in r[:13]) & set(x for r in d1 for x in r[14:]), set(x for r in d2 for x in r[:8]) & set(x for r in d2 for x in r[9:]))
print('test result:')
result=transform(T)
print(result)
